detailZones.title: Museum, firehouse and rail
detailZones.description: Tram line, domed museum, visible fossil displays, exhibit yard and adjoining firehouse.

detailZones.title: Fountain plaza and street
detailZones.description: Fountain, tree, taxi, crossing, delivery cart and street surfaces in the civic foreground.

detailZones.title: Station and canal café
detailZones.description: Western station frontage, bus bay, canal edge, corner building and café terraces.

detailZones.title: Crop beds and potting yard
detailZones.description: Explore the potting shed, raised vegetable beds, hand tools, wheelbarrow, and garden pond.

detailZones.title: Orchard and garden tools
detailZones.description: Study the cold frame, wildlife boxes, tomato supports, parked bicycle, and compost bays.

detailZones.title: Glasshouse and pond garden
detailZones.description: Inspect the glazed greenhouse, gazebo furniture, pond edge, and small garden cart.

detailZones.title: Apartment cutaway
detailZones.description: Rooftop terrace, bedroom, bathroom, living room, kitchen, dining furniture and staircase.

detailZones.title: Canal crossing
detailZones.description: Canal, arched bridge, shelter and clearly visible street furniture on the eastern waterfront.

detailZones.title: West homes and play yard
detailZones.description: Townhouse facade, laundry yard, shed, bicycle shelter, conservatory and playground equipment.

detailZones.title: Gazebo and fountain walk
detailZones.description: Follow the streamside path past the park gazebo, fountain, flower bed, benches, and lamps.

detailZones.title: Ancient oak habitat
detailZones.description: Zoom into the old oak, its nests and fungi, the woodland play trail, viewing deck, and rockery.

detailZones.title: Pond and marsh edge
detailZones.description: Examine the pond, marsh plants, water birds, footbridge, shoreline stones, and wetland flowers.
